episodes.h: TRUMPS PRIMETIME FLOP??? Trump Announces NOTHING, Wastes Everyone's Time
episodes.blurb: Nick calls Trump's prime-time address a flop with no Venezuela declaration, argues the administration's tariff, National Guard and deportation promises collapsed, and says voters should withhold votes without an immigration moratorium and no Iran war.
